name: final-verify
description: Undo/redo (move + rename), catalog Storage rail + wardrobe thumbnail, finish composer, A/B overlay.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: undo-move-test
steps.eval: (function(){var s=window.__store.getState();var items=s.items;if(!items.length)throw new Error('no items');var it=items[0];var id=it.id;var x0=it.position[0];s.pushHistory();s.moveItem(id,[x0+0.5,it.position[1]]);var moved=window.__store.getState().items.find(function(i){return i.id===id}).position[0];if(Math.abs(moved-(x0+0.5))>1e-6)throw new Error('move did not apply');window.__store.getState().undo();var back=window.__store.getState().items.find(function(i){return i.id===id}).position[0];if(Math.abs(back-x0)>1e-6)throw new Error('undo move failed: '+back+' vs '+x0);return 'move-undo-ok'})()

steps.name: undo-rename-test
steps.eval: (function(){var s=window.__store.getState();var it=s.items[0];var id=it.id;var n0=it.label;s.renameItem(id,'__TESTNAME__');if(window.__store.getState().items.find(function(i){return i.id===id}).label!=='__TESTNAME__')throw new Error('rename did not apply');window.__store.getState().undo();var back=window.__store.getState().items.find(function(i){return i.id===id}).label;if(back!==n0)throw new Error('undo rename failed');return 'rename-undo-ok'})()

steps.name: redo-test
steps.eval: (function(){var s=window.__store.getState();var it=s.items[0];var id=it.id;var x0=it.position[0];s.pushHistory();s.moveItem(id,[x0+0.3,it.position[1]]);window.__store.getState().undo();window.__store.getState().redo();var v=window.__store.getState().items.find(function(i){return i.id===id}).position[0];if(Math.abs(v-(x0+0.3))>1e-6)throw new Error('redo failed: '+v);window.__store.getState().undo();return 'redo-ok'})()
